doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Dreams, goals and money
summary: Asked about fulfilled dreams, Liston says she never made money and could now.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Because you used to say, whenever you would be sad or something, you’re horn would bring you out of it, but now you can’t depend on that, so Randy is your horn right now. Have you fulfilled all your dreams and goals and stuff for yourself, or did you have any new come along? You’ve written for everybody. You played with everybody.
I haven’t mad no money. So I could make some money now.
That’s probably what you’ll do, going back to New York. Like you said, they’ll be ready for you, and they won’t be piddly-paddling with the money.
